what: While scrolling down a long section (original 380vh), a one-screen panel stays pinned, and nine scattered photo pieces fly past the camera from deep within the perspective (screen height × 1.08, min 900px). Each piece moves from depth −perspective×depth (layers 1·2·3 default .38·.21·.06) to +perspective×(.64·.79·.92), with length 5.4 ÷ speed (.75~1.35). During the first .24 of its length opacity goes by layer (.24·.48·.78)→1, it vanishes at .8 of the length, and the photo inside the piece goes 1.075→1. It follows the scroll directly (scrub 1.05). The three large center sentences use a separate scrub 1: each rests, then exits in 1.25s power2.inOut, and the next sentence enters at 1.026 scale in 1.75s power2.out (.38s overlap)

options.scrub: Delay (sec) for photo pieces following the scroll, default 1.05
options.text-scrub: Delay of the sentence timeline (sec), default 1
options.life: Speed 1 piece length share, default 5.4 — lower it and the pieces pass faster
options.hold: Blank share left after all pieces have passed, default .8
options.[data-fx-part=stage]: One screen panel that stays pinned (required) — section height (how many screens) is set by the user
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Flying pieces — data-layer (1, 2, 3, higher is closer to the front), data-speed, data-depth (optional), position and size come from the user’s left, top, width. The first child shrinks from 1.075 to 1
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: Sentence in the panel center (optional) — only the first shows, then they change in turn
